body:
Split out of T-272 during the review fixes: the web's dialogs are plain divs with no `role="dialog"`, no `aria-modal`, no `aria-labelledby`, no focus trap when they open and no focus restore when they close, and Escape does not close them. The one concrete symptom that ticket named — the overlay click discarding a form when a text-selection drag ended outside the panel — is fixed (the overlay now closes only when mousedown and mouseup both land on it), as are the other T-272 items.

What is left is the focus and semantics work across four dialogs of different shapes (ItemDialog with its name-suggestion dropdown and store-input Enter handling, ExpenseDialog, the overview's create dialog, and the admin delete confirmation). That deserves its own tests and its own review rather than riding along with unrelated fixes; a native `<dialog>` is worth considering instead of hand-rolling the trap.
title: Web dialogs: no role, no labelling, no focus trap or restore, no Escape
